vanilla_climate_sample_xz_parts.conversion: injectors (@Redirect of the six DensityFunction.compute calls in Climate.Sampler.sample; @Inject at the RETURN of RandomState.<init>); the constructor is guarded because the copies are mapped from the router exactly as it builds the sampler
vanilla_climate_sample_xz_parts.license: Minecraft: no Minecraft code is carried; helper bons.furious.patch.climate_columns.ClimateParts maps the router with our own visitor and the existing bons.pure.terrain.XzCache / DensityAudit

yields.name: Generator Accelerator
yields.why: Generator Accelerator (tested 1.21.1-1.6.2) replaces Climate.Sampler.sample with its own @Overwrite at the default priority. Mixin refuses our @Redirects into a method another mixin overwrote at equal priority (the class fails to load and the game stops at the first world load), so this switch steps aside whenever that mixin is listed; Generator Accelerator then samples the climate its own way. Found by the crash-class sweep of the 1.21.1 port.
